newsitem.title: BULGARIA: BULGARIA BUDGET DEFICIT UP TO 605 BLN LVS END-JULY.
newsitem.headline: BULGARIA BUDGET DEFICIT UP TO 605 BLN LVS END-JULY.

text.p: Bulgaria's central government budget deficit rose by 175 billion levs in the second half of July to 605 billion levs or 64.6 percent of the annual target, a Finance Ministry official said, quoting preliminary figures.
"The deficit stood at 605 billion levs on July 31," the official told Reuters, declining to elaborate on the reasons for the rise.
BULGARIA BUDGET, bln levs JULY 31 JULY 17
Deficit at end-July was around 3.75 percent of the nominal 1997 gross domestic product (GDP) of 16.15 trillion levs assumed in this year's budget.

The central government budget deficit for the fiscal 1997, which in Bulgaria coincides with the calendar year, was projected at 6.2 percent of GDP with revenue seen at 27.3 percent of GDP and expenditure at 33.5 percent. -- Sofia Newsroom +359-2 91188
